## Venn diagram of common receptors

```{r}
venn_receptors <- list(
  LLC = LLC_receptors,
  B16 = B16_receptors,
  C26 = C26_receptors,
  KPC = KPC_receptors
)

ggvenn(venn_receptors,
       fill_color = c("#CC79A7", "#009E73", "#E69F00", "#0072B2"),
       stroke_color = "black",
       text_size = 5,
       show_percentage = FALSE) +
  ggtitle("Common Receptors") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  size = 16,
                                  face = "bold"))
```

#### NOTE - since there are only 2 that are common across all of them, going to do DEGs between all tumour-bearing muscle to get KEGG terms. May be skewed by highly expressed receptors in one model and by the number of cells in each condition, but there is more to work with.


## KEGG pathway analysis
### Get DEGs of receptors in tumour-bearing muscle

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(sc_combined) <- "orig.ident"

DEGs_sc_combined <- FindMarkers(sc_combined, ident.1 = c("Agca_snLLC_LLC", "Brown_scLLC_2w", "Brown_scLLC_2.5w", "Brown_scLLC_3.5w", "Kim_scB16F10_B16F10", "Pryce_scC26_C26", "Pryce_scKPP_KPP", "Zhang_snKIC_KIC"), ident.2 = c("Agca_snLLC_CTL", "Brown_scLLC_CTL", "Kim_scB16F10_CTL", "Pryce_scC26_CTL", "Pryce_scKPP_CTL", "Zhang_snKIC_CTL"), logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0.10, verbose = FALSE)
```

### Subset DEG for p_val_adj < 0.05 and avg_log2FC > 0.2 and in common_receptors

```{r}
DEGs_sc_combined <- subset(DEGs_sc_combined, p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC > 0.2)

DEGs_sc_combined <- DEGs_sc_combined[rownames(DEGs_sc_combined) %in% common_receptors,
]

rownames(DEGs_sc_combined)
```

### KEGG pathway analysis

```{r, include=FALSE}
### Convert gene symbols to Entrez IDs
DEGs_sc_combined_gene_names <- rownames(DEGs_sc_combined)

DEGs_sc_combined_IDs <- bitr(DEGs_sc_combined_gene_names,
                  fromType = "SYMBOL",
                  toType   = "ENTREZID",
                  OrgDb    = org.Mm.eg.db)

DEGs_sc_combined_kegg <- enrichKEGG(
  gene         = DEGs_sc_combined_IDs$ENTREZID,
  organism     = "mmu",
  keyType      = "kegg",
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05
)

write.csv(DEGs_sc_combined_kegg, file = "kegg_common_receptors.csv", row.names = TRUE)
```

### Visualize KEGG pathways

```{r}
sc_combined_pathways <- c(1:18)
sc_combined_kegg_signaling <- DEGs_sc_combined_kegg[sc_combined_pathways, ]

sc_combined_kegg_signaling$Description <- gsub(" - Mus musculus \\(house mouse\\)$", "", sc_combined_kegg_signaling$Description)

ggplot(sc_combined_kegg_signaling, aes(x = FoldEnrichment, 
                           y = reorder(Description, FoldEnrichment),
                           size = Count, 
                           color = p.adjust)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red", name = "adj. p-value") +
  labs(x = "Fold Enrichment", y = NULL, 
       title = "UP KEGG Tumour-bearing muscle") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black")
  )
```

# Score cells for receptor expression

```{r, include=FALSE}
sc_combined_receptors_score <- AddModuleScore_UCell(sc_combined, features = list(common_receptors), name = "sc_combined_receptors_score")

means_sc_combined_receptors_score <- sc_combined_receptors_score@meta.data %>%
  group_by(seurat_clusters) %>%
  summarise(average_sc_combined_receptors_score = mean(signature_1sc_combined_receptors_score, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
print(means_sc_combined_receptors_score)
```

```{r}
cluster_colours <- c(
    "Satellite cells"      = "#FF7FBF",
    "Myoblasts"            = "#FF3F80",
    "Myonuclei"            = "#E00000",
    "Endothelial cells"    = "#FFFF00",
    "vSMCs"                = "#BC9D00",

    "Platelets"            = "#D46A6A", 
    "Mast cells"           = "#C85C8C", 
    "Dendritic cells"      = "#B84D9E", 
    "Monocytes"            = "#80E5FF",
    "Macrophages"          = "#1E90FF",
    "Neutrophils"          = "#4169E1",
    "B cells"              = "#C9A2FF",
    "T cells"              = "#B44CFF",
    "NK cells"             = "#5B0E8A",

)

VlnPlot(sc_combined_receptors_score, features = "signature_1sc_combined_receptors_score", group.by = "seurat_clusters", pt.size = 0) +
```

# What receptor genes are upregulated in tumour-bearing Monocytes?

### Subset for Monocytes

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(sc_combined) <- "seurat_clusters"

sc_combined_monocytes <- subset(sc_combined, idents = "Monocytes")
```

### DEGs in tumour-bearing monocytes

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(sc_combined_monocytes) <- "orig.ident"

DEGs_sc_combined_monocytes <- FindMarkers(sc_combined_monocytes, ident.1 = c("Agca_snLLC_LLC", "Brown_scLLC_2w", "Brown_scLLC_2.5w", "Brown_scLLC_3.5w", "Kim_scB16F10_B16F10", "Pryce_scC26_C26", "Pryce_scKPP_KPP", "Zhang_snKIC_KIC"), ident.2 = c("Agca_snLLC_CTL", "Brown_scLLC_CTL", "Kim_scB16F10_CTL", "Pryce_scC26_CTL", "Pryce_scKPP_CTL", "Zhang_snKIC_CTL"), logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0.10, verbose = FALSE)
```

### Subset DEGs for p_val_adj < 0.05, avg_log2FC > 0.2, included in common_receptors

```{r}
DEGs_sc_combined_monocytes <- subset(DEGs_sc_combined_monocytes, p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC > 0.2)

DEGs_sc_combined_monocytes <- DEGs_sc_combined_monocytes[
    rownames(DEGs_sc_combined_monocytes) %in% common_receptors,
]

rownames(DEGs_sc_combined_monocytes)
```

## Mean expression values of DEGs in monocytes (to manually make heatmap)

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Subset monocytes
Idents(sc_combined) <- "seurat_clusters"
monocytes <- subset(sc_combined, idents = "Monocytes")

# Make sure 'condition' exists
ctl_samples <- c(
  "Agca_snLLC_CTL",
  "Brown_scLLC_CTL",
  "Kim_scB16F10_CTL",
  "Pryce_scC26_CTL",
  "Pryce_scKPP_CTL",
  "Zhang_snKIC_CTL"
)

monocytes$condition <- ifelse(monocytes$orig.ident %in% ctl_samples,
                              "CTL",
                              "Tumour")

# Set condition as identity
Idents(monocytes) <- "condition"

# Set default assay
DefaultAssay(monocytes) <- "RNA"

# Keep only genes present in monocytes
genes_mono <- intersect(DEGs_mono_macro, rownames(monocytes))

# Compute mean expression per condition
avg_expr_monocytes <- AverageExpression(
  monocytes,
  features = genes_mono,
  group.by = "condition",
  return.seurat = FALSE
)$RNA

# View the result
avg_expr_monocytes
```
